page.overview:
Who is Sean Gelael?

Muhammad Sean Ricardo Gelael (born 1 November 1996 at Jakarta, Special Capital Region of Jakarta, Indonesia) is an Indonesian racing driver who serves as a development driver for Toro Rosso. Prior to his signing, Gelael drove in FIA Formula 2 Championship.
